item.title: DDS2 Parkour Guide: Movement Mechanics and Police Escape
item.description:
The DDS2 Fandom tutorial page confirms: "Use parkour to find shortcuts, to make it easier to escape from enemies chasing you, or to sneak into otherwise inaccessible areas." Parkour is your primary survival tool -- not guns. I stopped trying to fight police after my first few arrests.

Parkour actions:

Action Key Use Case
Vault Space (toward obstacle) Low fences, barriers
Wall Run Space (toward wall at angle) Narrow alleys, building gaps
Jump Climb Space (toward ledge) Roof access, vertical escape
Sprint Shift Open ground between cover
Crouch/Slide Ctrl Break line of sight

These moves are specifically designed for finding shortcuts between sectors, escaping police and enemy chases, and reaching otherwise inaccessible areas.

item.title: DDS2 Police Evasion: Parkour Escape Routes and Heat Management
item.description:
Police in DDS2 have a heat system similar to open-world crime games. Your wanted level (None to Person of Interest to Suspect to Wanted) determines pursuit intensity. Parkour breaks line of sight faster than any other method I have found.

Wanted level system:

Based on the Fandom hideout page and community discussions:

Level Name Police Behavior How to Reduce
0 None Standard patrols No action needed
1 Person of Interest Increased patrols in area 3-5 min inactivity
2 Suspect Active search, roadblocks 5-10 min, avoid crime
3 Wanted Pursuit, helicopter 10+ min, hide in safe spot
